_meta.purpose: Lineage-recall question battery. Tests whether a format preserves WHO did WHAT in WHICH session — the property prose summary cannot represent without re-emitting overhead. Designed to falsify-or-validate v3.0's claim that dream-merged threads preserve lineage cheaply.
_meta.scoring: case-insensitive substring; an answer counts as correct if it contains ANY string in any_of

category_legend.fact: atomic fact (any format should answer these)
category_legend.evolution: decisions that changed over time (prose summary likely fails)
category_legend.cross_model: presence of non-Claude families (only audit-thread can answer)
